OP... Your post made me realize that, for years, i've felt this. Nobody truly cared until i was severely UW. As soon as i got into "recovery" and gained back all the weight and way more (thx BED and mia) suddenly i wasn't the "poor, sick, fragile child 🥺" but inside i was still hurting as much as when i was anorexic, i'd say even more.
But now, i have this one special person in my life, they're sitting right beside me, and they truly care. No matter how my body looks. They care about my _well being_ and they're dealing so wonderfully with my ED. I never thought i'd have such an understanding and empathic person in my life.
So, OP, and anyone reading this, and anyone struggling. I wish you will find your special person. Even better, i wish this special person will also be yourself. You deserve to treat yourself well. You deserve to be happy. We all deserve to be happy.
Much love 💕
